subject: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)

Team,

Quick ask: OpenRetail (Nina Gomez) converted a handful of freemium users into a 40-seat pilot and is asking for an expanded self-serve trial credit to cover API usage while they finish integration tests. They are close to an expansion deal but need predictable low-cost inference for the pilot month.

Summary:
- Requested credit: $75,000 equivalent (token-based) to cover expected test traffic over 30 days.
- Why: Integration latency tests, model A/B during pilot, and realistic embeds workload.
- Ask: Leadership sign-off to issue as a one-time self-serve credit (no contract amendment) OR explicit exception to the standard $10k free credits policy.
- Impact: If we approve, ops can apply credits via console for immediate use; this materially shortens time to value and keeps momentum for expansion.

Attachments: openretail_trial_usage.csv (sample usage), proposed_mop_plan.pdf (pilot plan)

I've included Karthik for churn/forecast impact and Tessa for compliance/ops gating. If Aditya can weigh in on risk/precedent, I can reply to Nina with next steps.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)

Jonas — thanks for the concise summary. Two quick operational questions before I escalate: 

1) Can we limit the credit to a single provider-id/projects (so it can't be reused across future accounts)?
2) What is the plan if they hit the cap early? Do we throttle or auto-escalate to a paid path?

Karthik — please include a short note on forecasted ARR conversion probability if we push this through. We want to ensure this doesn't create a bad discounting precedent.

Tessa — if ops can do a scoped self-serve issue (project-level credit + expiry + usage alert), please outline steps and any manual checks you need.

If answers look clean I'll put it to Aditya for signoff; if he approves, ops should be able to issue today.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)

Laura / Jonas — quick forecast note attached: baseline conversion probability for a PLG pilot at this scale is ~28% within 90 days, uplift to ~36% if we keep them on a low-friction test environment (i.e., self-serve credits).

Financials: assume ~60% net retention in year one of initial expansion; expected first-year ARR for a successful expansion ~ $220k.

I think this is a high-leverage use of credits, but we should attach a short MAP (mutual action plan) to the issuance: milestone 1 (integration verified), milestone 2 (initial paid seats), milestone 3 (SLA discussion).

Karthik
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)

Ops checks: We can issue a scoped project-level credit with a fixed expiry (30 days), usage alert at 70% and hard cap at 100%. Required items from sales to proceed:
- Confirm project id and account owner email
- Signed MAP acceptance (short doc) or a confirmation email from the customer acknowledging pilot constraints

Attachment: credit-terms-draft.docx (templated language).

If Sales can get that confirmation from Nina, I'll queue the credit issuance and set up monitoring for anomalous bursts. No platform changes required.

Tessa Morgan
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High-value trial grant request: OpenRetail PLG pilot (self-serve issuance)

I've reviewed the ask and the attachments. I approve a one-time scoped trial grant of up to $75,000 in credits for OpenRetail under the following constraints: 

- Issuance must be project-level and non-transferable.
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance.
- Usage monitoring enabled; ops to pause on anomalous spikes and notify sales immediately.
- Customer must sign the attached MAP/acceptance email before credits go live.

Tessa — please proceed to queue the self-serve credit issuance once Jonas confirms the project id and we have the MAP confirmation from Nina. Jonas, after issuance, update the HubSpot deal (OR-2026-014) with issuance timestamp and attach the MAP.

Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations (Interim) | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
